rows.en:
(The guy who came as Ranka's bodyguard...
With that blank face, I can never tell
what he's thinking...)
Hey.

(He just stands at the back of the room
with a blank face all through class,
so everyone's kind of on edge...)
Hey. You there.

Huh!
M-Me?
Yes. I hear you're close to Ranka.
Oh, yes, we get along really well.

I see...
Then there's no problem.

(Um... Did he stop me
just to ask me that?)
rows.notes: Name plate says Brera, but the line is the male player's inner monologue (brackets, boku); translated as the player's thought.

rows.en: However...!!

If you ever hurt Ranka,
I will eliminate you that very instant!
Remember that, if nothing else.

(Wh-What on earth was that just now...
Is that part of a bodyguard's job too?)

(Hmm... Come to think of it, I feel like
something like this happened before...?)

(The guy who came as Ranka-chan's bodyguard...
With that blank face, I can never tell
what he's thinking...)

Huh!
M-Me?

(Um... Did he stop me
just to ask me that?)
rows.notes: Name plate says Brera, but the line is the female player's inner monologue (brackets, watashi); translated as the player's thought.

rows.en:
(Wh-What on earth was that just now...
Is that part of a bodyguard's job too?)

(Summer vacation, huh...
What should I do this summer...)

Hello, \p-kun.
It's hot again today, isn't it?
Sure is... *sigh*
You seem kind of low on energy.

Ahaha... The summer heat's getting to me...
You look full of energy, Senpai.

You've got to cut loose in summer at least,
you know?
...Okaaay.

(Senpai looks so cool, like the heat
doesn't even touch her.)

Hello, \p-chan.
It's hot again today, isn't it?
(Senpai sure is full of energy.)

(In a month, I'll get to meet the Galactic Fairy
herself. Seriously, it's like a dream...)

What's got you so excited,
\p-kun?
Claire-senpai!
Are you going to Sheryl's concert, Senpai?
I wanted to, but I couldn't get a ticket.
Are you going?

...Actually, I'm going to be doing
an EX-Gear stunt there.
...Wow, that's amazing!
I'm going to give it everything I've got.
Good luck. I'll be cheering for you.
(I can't wait for the concert!)

(In a month, I'll get to meet the Galactic Fairy
herself. Seriously, it's like a dream...)

What's got you so excited,
\p-chan?
Are you going to Sheryl's concert, Senpai?
(I can't wait for the concert!)

(Looks like everyone's finally settling down...
I guess finding a destination really makes
a difference.)

Oh, \p-kun.
Have you been well?
Yes, more or less.

A new planet's been found,
and you're awfully calm about it.

I'm excited too, you know!
It's just that I don't know what I should do.

I know.
It's all still way too vague to make sense of.
Well, let's figure it out together.

(Looks like everyone's finally settling down...
I wonder if finding a destination really makes
that much of a difference.)

\p-chan,
have you been well?
Yes, pretty well.

I'm excited too, you know!
It's just that I don't know what I should do.

(...It's the middle of the night,
but I'm getting hungry...)

For a midnight snack, cup ramen's the way to go.
...Huh, who's that over there...?
Claire-senpai, what are you doing...?
Y-You must have the wrong person.

There's no way I'd mistake you.
Are you restocking on late-night snacks too, Senpai?
Th-That's not it, okay? I did not buy any cake!
I'm telling you, I didn't buy any!
(So she bought cake.)

For a midnight snack, cup ramen's the way to go~
...Huh, who's that over there...?
Claire-senpai, what are you doing?
(So she bought cake.)

uncertain: c15933/c15941: name plate in the script is Brera, but the text is the player's bracketed inner monologue (boku/watashi); translated as the player's thought. Worth checking in game.
c15938 (shared m/f): "something like this happened before" presumably alludes to Ozma's similar warning in another scene; kept vague as in the Japanese.
c15953/c15964: "meet the Galactic Fairy" (Sheryl, glossary title); a month before the concert where the player does an EX-Gear stunt (c15959).
